content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: Retired government servant such as SDM / Tehsildar or equivalent, with work experience in land administration, survey, registration, revenue, consolidation etc. Experience required: Work experience in land administration, survey, registration, revenue, consolidation etc. Pay: Rs. 1.00 lakh per month. Qualification required: B.Tech / B.E. (Computer Science / IT / Electronics) or MCA / M.Tech (GIS, Remote Sensing, Geoinformatics or Computer Science); M.Tech / MCA preferred; minimum 5 years' work experience, at least 2 years in Land Information System, digital mapping or land administration projects. Experience required: Minimum 5 years' work experience, of which at least 2 years in Land Information System, digital mapping, urban or rural land administration projects. Pay: Rs. 1.00 lakh per month. Qualification required: (i) For support of Land Record Expert: Post Graduate degree in Law (LL.B. / LL.M.), Public Administration, Geography, Economics or Social Science; 3 to 5 years' experience. (ii) For support of IT & GIS Expert: B.Tech / B.E. (Computer Science / IT / Electronics) or MCA, M.Sc. / M.Tech (GIS, Remote Sensing, Geoinformatics, Geography or Geomatics); 3 to 5 years' experience. Experience required: 3 to 5 years' practical work or research experience in the relevant field. Pay: Rs. 0.70 lakh per month. Qualification required: Graduate degree from a recognised university, preferably in BBA, Public Administration, Social Work (BSW), Education (B.Ed.) or Computer Application (BCA); minimum 1 to 2 years' experience. Experience required: Minimum 1 to 2 years' practical experience in training management, event coordination or administrative work. Pay: Rs. 0.50 lakh per month. Qualification required: Graduate degree from a recognised university; one-year computer diploma (such as O Level, DCA, PGDCA) or degree in Computer Science / IT; typing 25 wpm in Hindi and English; minimum 1 to 2 years' experience. Experience required: Minimum 1 to 2 years' relevant experience of data entry or IT support in a government department or corporate office. Pay: Rs. 0.30 lakh per month.
